wnba.Description: Seattle Storm (6-17, 1-12 Western Conference) at Atlanta Dream (12-9, 7-3 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Sydney Taylor scores 10 of her 16 points in the 3rd quarter and the Sky beat the Mercury 77-66
wnba.Description: — Sydney Taylor scored 10 of her 16 points in the third quarter, Natasha Cloud finished with 11 points and six assists, and the Chicago Sky beat the Phoenix Mercury 77-66 on Tuesday night.

wnba.Headline: Phoenix Mercury vs. Chicago Sky - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Phoenix Mercury vs. Chicago Sky, 07/07/2026

wnba.Headline: Jessica Shepard secures 3rd triple-double of the season and the Wings beat the Liberty 88-77
wnba.Description: — Jessica Shepard had 22 points, 12 rebounds and 11 assists for her third triple-double of the season, and the Dallas Wings beat the New York Liberty 88-77 on Tuesday night.

wnba.Headline: New York Liberty vs. Dallas Wings - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from New York Liberty vs. Dallas Wings, 07/07/2026

wnba.Headline: Who has the most triple-doubles in WNBA history? Key stats
wnba.Description: A triple-double is an impressive feat. Which WNBA players have achieved it? Check out a historical rundown of stat leaders.

wnba.Headline: Sparks' Nneka Ogwumike headlines WNBA All-Star Game reserves
wnba.Description: Los Angeles Sparks forward Nneka Ogwumike headlines the 12 reserves selected by league coaches Tuesday for the WNBA All-Star Game on July 25 in Chicago.

wnba.Headline: Fever's Clark hopeful to play Wed., says back-to-back unlikely
wnba.Description: Fever star Caitlin Clark, who has spent the past two weeks rehabbing from a back injury, said she is "very hopeful" to play Wednesday against the Sparks but admitted it would be difficult for her to play the next day against the Mercury.

wnba.Headline: Guard Chennedy Carter waived by champion Las Vegas Aces
wnba.Description: Guard Chennedy Carter, the No. 4 pick by the Atlanta Dream in the 2020 draft out of Texas A&M, has been waived by the Aces, the team announced Tuesday. She played in 13 of Las Vegas' 21 games, averaging 12.2 points.

wnba.Headline: Geno Auriemma says hard fouls on Caitlin Clark not a 'referendum on America'
wnba.Description: Geno Auriemma says on-court confrontations involving Caitlin Clark should not be viewed as a "referendum on America."

wnba.Headline: How to watch Robin Roberts, Geno Auriemma WNBA broadcast
wnba.Description: Robin Roberts and Geno Auriemma turn back the clock by broadcasting Wings vs. Liberty, 30 years after calling ESPN's first WNBA game. Here's how to catch the broadcast.

wnba.Headline: WNBA Power Rankings: Valkyries ride 5-win streak to No. 1
wnba.Description: Golden State's defense and depth are paying dividends as the top spot once again changes hands.

wnba.Headline: Minnesota visits Connecticut after Griner's 29-point game
wnba.Description: Minnesota Lynx (15-6, 10-1 Western Conference) at Connecticut Sun (5-16, 2-8 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Golden State plays Toronto on 5-game win streak
wnba.Description: Golden State Valkyries (15-7, 7-5 Western Conference) at Toronto Tempo (9-11, 4-6 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Flau’jae Johnson scores 23 and the Storm beat the Sparks 82-64
wnba.Description: — Flau’jae Johnson scored 23 points, Natisha Hiedeman added 15 and the Seattle Storm beat the Los Angeles Sparks 82-64 on Monday night.

wnba.Headline: Los Angeles Sparks vs. Seattle Storm - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Los Angeles Sparks vs. Seattle Storm, 07/06/2026

wnba.Headline: Brittney Griner scores 29 and Kennedy Burke hits 2 late 3-pointers in the Sun's 90-89 win over Lynx
wnba.Description: — Brittney Griner scored a season-high 29 points and grabbed 10 rebounds, Kennedy Burke added 16 points off the bench, including two 3-pointers in the final three minutes, and the Connecticut Sun beat the Minnesota Lynx 90-89 on Monday night.
